title: Compute temperature ratios and write results
action: Compute the intermediate temperature ratio Tb/Ta using the metallic isentrope integral approximation exp(γ * ΔP / B_S) with the given constants Grüneisen parameter γ, isentropic bulk modulus B_S, and pressure interval ΔP. Then compute the path‑decomposition temperature ratio T2/T1_path as Tb/Ta multiplied by the given DKR‑2 isobaric cooling factor. Compute the Clausius‑Clapeyron temperature ratio T2/T1_CC using the approximation exp(ΔV_IM * ΔP / ΔH_IM) with the given volume change ΔV_IM and latent heat ΔH_IM, after appropriate unit conversion to ensure consistent units. Write all three numbers to temperature_ratio_results.json.
description: JSON file containing the three computed temperature ratios.
